meta.rule: item6-style corrected and smoothed industry wage share weighted by BEA T018 private gross output
meta.gross_output_is: activity proxy including intermediate production, not value added or measured service use
meta.excluded_output: HS housing; all government industries; no private-household/noindustry output
meta.freight_goods: agriculture incl forestry/fishing, mining, durable and nondurable manufacturing; construction excluded
meta.mining_fixed: zero mining numerator with full national denominator; hybrid = this partial share + mining_output_fraction * baseline household/consumption key
meta.factor_rule: union/generations divide case wage shares; white_nh divides its corrected lane plain wage share
meta.replicate_rule: index 0 main estimate; indexes 1-160 CPS SDR; covariance = 4/160 sum replicate deviations outer product
meta.uncertainty: CPS replicate SE conditional on national output, top pooling and main fillin factors; fillin/model uncertainty not included
